description: The overall average option volume ratio is the plain average of the option volume ratio across every sentiment snapshot.

a.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and to that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), dropping snapshots without both matches. For each combination of transaction reference (`transref`) and trader type (`tradekind`), compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`). Take as the baseline the plain average of `optvolrt` over all sentiment snapshots, including those without a matching transaction or trader. Each combination's deviation is its average minus the baseline (no rows if the baseline is missing). Within each trader type, average those deviations. Keep only the combinations whose deviation is above their trader type's average deviation, and give each one an excess: its deviation minus the type's average deviation. Combinations with no trader type get a deviation too but are dropped at this comparison. Finally, for each trader type, report the type, the average of the kept combinations' average option volume ratios, the average of their deviations, and the average of their excess. Averages ignore missing values. No rounding.
a.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), combo AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS combo_avg FROM joined GROUP BY transref, tradekind), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS base FROM sentimentandfundamentals), dev AS (SELECT c.transref, c.tradekind, c.combo_avg, c.combo_avg - b.base AS deviation FROM combo c CROSS JOIN baseline b), typed AS (SELECT tradekind, combo_avg, deviation, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM dev WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT tradekind, combo_avg, deviation, deviation - type_avg_dev AS excess FROM typed WHERE deviation > type_avg_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(combo_avg) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind;

b.request: For each trader type, over matched pairs of (transref, tradekind) with non-null tradekind, where the overall mean is the plain average of optvolrt across all sentimentandfundamentals rows: average the pair's optvolrt, take the signed deviation from that overall mean, keep pairs whose deviation exceeds the type's mean deviation, and report the kept pairs' averages of optvolrt, deviation, and excess over the type's mean deviation
b.sql:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_mean FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS pair_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2
  WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
dev AS (
  SELECT p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - o.overall_mean AS deviation
  FROM pairs p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
),
typed AS (
  SELECT tradekind, pair_avg, deviation,
         AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_mean_dev
  FROM dev
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_optvolrt,
       AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(deviation - type_mean_dev) AS avg_excess
FROM typed
WHERE deviation > type_mean_dev
GROUP BY tradekind
ORDER BY tradekind;

c.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), keeping only full matches, and compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`) for each transaction reference and trader type (`tradekind`) pair. Measure each pair's deviation from the overall average option volume ratio (no rows if that's missing). Then, within each trader type, keep only the pairs whose deviation beats the type's average deviation, and note by how much (pairs with no trader type drop out at this step). For each trader type, what are the average option volume ratio, the average deviation and the average excess of those pairs? Averages ignore missing values. Don't round. The overall average option volume ratio is the plain average of the option volume ratio across every sentiment snapshot.
c.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals), pairs AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS pair_optvolrt, AVG(s.optvolrt) - o.overall_avg AS dev FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind, o.overall_avg), typed AS (SELECT tradekind, pair_optvolrt, dev, dev - AVG(dev) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS excess FROM pairs) SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(dev) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM typed WHERE excess > 0 GROUP BY tradekind

d.request: Using the plain average of `optvolrt` across all sentiment snapshots as the overall average, link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), keeping only full matches. Compute the average `optvolrt` for each transaction reference and trader type (`tradekind`) pair, and measure each pair's deviation from that overall average (no rows if it is missing). Then, within each trader type, keep only the pairs whose deviation beats the type's average deviation, and note by how much (pairs with no trader type drop out at this step). For each trader type, what are the average option volume ratio, the average deviation, and the average excess of those pairs? Averages ignore missing values, and results should not be rounded.
d.sql:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
  WHERE tr.tradekind IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind
  HAVING AVG(s.optvolrt) IS NOT NULL
),
dev AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_optvolrt,
         p.avg_optvolrt - o.overall_avg AS deviation
  FROM pairs p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
),
typed AS (
  SELECT d.tradekind, d.avg_optvolrt, d.deviation,
         AVG(d.deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev
  FROM dev d
),
kept AS (
  SELECT tradekind, avg_optvolrt, deviation,
         deviation - type_avg_dev AS excess
  FROM typed
  WHERE deviation > type_avg_dev
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio,
       AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM kept
GROUP BY tradekind;
